Reset to defaults

    
This clears every added character, source, note, image and sequence in this browser and restores the template. Export a JSON backup first if you want to keep your work.

    

      
      
    

  







  

  

    
Team access · GitHub

    

    
The shared copy of the bible lives as a data file in your GitHub repository. Anyone with the page link can view it; only people whose GitHub token has write access to the repository can change and save it. Every save is a commit, so you get “saved by” and a full version history.

Your GitHub access token — editors only; leave blank to view

      
      
      
The token stays in this browser and is only ever sent to api.github.com.

    


    

      How to create an editor token
      
    
        
  1. The repository owner adds each editor as a collaborator with Write access (Settings → Collaborators).
    2. 
        
  2. Each editor opens github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new.
    3. 
        
  3. Repository access → Only select repositories → pick this repository.
    4. 
        
  4. Permissions → Repository → Contents: Read and write. Generate and paste it here.
    5. 
        
  5. Private repository? Viewers also need a token, with Contents: Read-only.
    6.
